opportunities.title: Fix 日経225 traffic landing on the contact page
opportunities.summary: About 184K monthly searches for 日経225 resolve to a support contact page instead of a page that explains the market and leads to registration.
evidence: /jp/contact is the ranking URL and is flagged Misrouted in site pages (1.1K clicks).
opportunities.action: Create or choose a Nikkei 225 page, re-point internal links and metadata, and remove 日経225 targeting from the contact page.
opportunities.validation: Search Console clicks and position for 日経225 four weeks after the change; registration starts from the new landing page once events exist.

opportunities.title: Reclaim broken backlinks to /jp/faq and /jp/jp
opportunities.summary: High-authority sites link to XM URLs that now return errors, so the link value is lost.
evidence: Broken backlinks from DR 93 sources (ameblo.jp, note.com) point at /jp/faq.
/jp/jp is also linked from high-DR sources and is broken.
opportunities.action: Redirect the broken URLs (301) to the closest live pages such as the help centre and Japan homepage, then re-run the broken-backlinks report.
opportunities.validation: Broken backlink count in Ahrefs falls; referring-domain value to the target pages rises. No registrations are modelled for this item.

opportunities.title: Optimise the MT5 and MT4 download pages (positions 9 and 10)
opportunities.summary: People searching for trading platforms are close to opening an account, and XM already ranks just off the top results.
evidence: mt4ダウンロード: 3.4K searches, XM ranks #9; xmスプレッド: 1K searches, #6.
xm mt4 ダウンロード: position 1, difficulty 22. Defend it.
opportunities.action: Refresh titles, headings and content on /jp/mt5 and /jp/mt4, add internal links from high-traffic pages, and place a registration call to action next to the download.
opportunities.validation: Position and clicks for the three keywords in Search Console; registration starts from both pages.

opportunities.title: Connect Search Console and registration events
opportunities.summary: Today the tool can only show estimated clicks. Without first-party data we cannot tell which pages and markets produce registrations.
evidence: Google Search Console is not connected.
Registration start and completion events are not collected.
opportunities.action: Connect Search Console for xmtrading.com, then add events for registration start and completion that carry the landing page and traffic source.
opportunities.validation: This tool shows measured clicks, registration starts and completions per landing page and market.

opportunities.title: Publish an XM portal redesign and migration guide
opportunities.summary: Customers and prospects search for answers about the new portal, and a third-party review site answers them.
evidence: KaigaiFX ranks for 'xm インターフェースが変わった' (1,070 searches, 136 clicks).
No official XM page answering this is in the top-30 pages.
opportunities.action: Publish a change log covering wallet, login and MT4/MT5 migration, and link it from the login page.
opportunities.validation: Clicks to the guide, drop in competitor clicks for the redesign queries, support tickets on the same topics. Mostly protects existing customers, not new registrations.

opportunities.title: Create a TradingView compatibility guide
opportunities.summary: 97.8K monthly searches for TradingView and no dedicated XM page ranks. The traffic XM gets lands on a gold campaign page.
evidence: トレーディングビュー: 97.8K searches, 861 estimated clicks, no ranking page.
opportunities.action: Create an official guide covering compatibility, setup and limitations, with a registration call to action.
opportunities.validation: Position and clicks for トレーディングビュー and xmtrading tradingview; registration starts from the guide.

opportunities.title: Build a Nikkei 225 and futures market hub
opportunities.summary: The largest demand pool in the data. Informational visitors convert slowly, so this builds reach rather than quick registrations.
evidence: 日経平均先物: 760.9K searches; XM ranks #8 with 4.7K estimated clicks.
Rakuten captures 49.1K clicks on the same query; Monex's futures guide gets 19.4K.
opportunities.action: Build a durable hub page for Nikkei 225 and futures with market context and a path into registration. Pair it with OPP-01.
opportunities.validation: Position and clicks for the hub's keyword cluster; share of non-brand clicks (now 12.6%).

opportunities.title: Consolidate a withdrawal timing and status guide
opportunities.summary: Withdrawal questions affect trust, which affects registration. XM has partial coverage spread across support articles.
evidence: 海外fx 出金 最新情報: 360 searches, new query.
KaigaiFX's withdrawal guide gets about 116 estimated clicks.
An XM FXPlus article covers bank withdrawal timing.
opportunities.action: Merge the support content into one canonical, regularly updated guide.
opportunities.validation: Clicks and position for withdrawal queries; support contacts on the topic.

opportunities.title: Add an indexable economic calendar
opportunities.summary: Monex gets large organic traffic from a calendar page. XM may already have a tool that search engines cannot see.
evidence: Monex calendar page: about 29.3K estimated organic clicks.
No calendar page appears in XM's top-30 pages. Verify first.
opportunities.action: Check existing tools, then consolidate into one indexable Japan calendar page.
opportunities.validation: Indexation of the page, clicks, and registration starts from it.

opportunities.title: Decide a comparison content strategy for 海外fx おすすめ
opportunities.summary: The search closest to a registration decision. It is also the hardest to win and the most sensitive for compliance.
evidence: 海外fx おすすめ: 18.2K searches, XM at position 10, 160 estimated clicks, difficulty 81.
opportunities.action: Agree with Compliance what XM may publish before any page is built.
opportunities.validation: A written content policy; position and clicks for the keyword once a page exists.

opportunities.title: Review affiliate sites ranking for XM terms
opportunities.summary: Affiliate and review sites capture searches that mention XM and may promote competitors.
evidence: fxsignup.com shares 1,293 keywords with XM (31% of its keywords).
KaigaiFX's XM comparison page is rated Critical for relevance.
opportunities.action: Map which affiliate sites rank for XM brand and platform queries, which brokers they promote, and check partner compliance.
opportunities.validation: A reviewed list of sites with actions per site.

opportunities.title: Create a trust and verification hub
opportunities.summary: Competitors publish review pages. XM's regulation and 'who we are' pages exist but are separate.
evidence: XM's regulation and who-we-are pages exist separately.
opportunities.action: Draft a compliant hub linking regulation, security and policies.
opportunities.validation: Clicks to the hub; registration rate of visitors who viewed it, once events exist.

opportunities.title: Assess calculator and currency converter tools
opportunities.summary: Exness launched two utility pages. XM has an all-in-one calculator but no converter was detected.
opportunities.action: Decide whether to extend the existing calculator or add a converter.

notPursuing.title: cTrader chart tutorials
notPursuing.reason: XM offers MT4, MT5 and TraderPro, not cTrader. It is KaigaiFX's strongest new page, but we should not create content unless product support changes.

notPursuing.title: NISA and mutual-fund guides
notPursuing.reason: Very high demand (for example オルカン チャート 684K, 子供NISA 283K), but outside the leveraged-trading proposition. High volume would bring the wrong intent.
